name: chamber_edge_uniformity
description: Scenario B, and the ADR-010 continuity anchor. One etch chamber develops radial non-uniformity part-way through the horizon: the hidden edge_uniformity latent ramps over a week and then sustains, which moves post-etch CD at the edge sites and widens the within-wafer spread, raises edge-ring defect intensity on the wafers that chamber etched, and kills die at large radius through geometry alone. Nothing labels the chamber and nothing subtracts from yield; the observable consequence is whatever the physics produced. The diagnostic task is to attribute this to the chamber rather than to the tool, to the co-routed products, or to the ordinary chamber-to-chamber differences every world has.
